page_title: LIL 2-1 LEN | Lille v Lens 29/03/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+6' Lille take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
90+2' Paulo Fonseca decides to make a substitution. Jonathan David will be replaced by Trevis Dago (Lille).
90+1' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Hakon Arnar Haraldsson leaves the pitch and Ivan Cavaleiro (Lille) comes on.
90' We will have 6 min. of added time.
90' Lens have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
89' The main referee, Willy Delajod, is apparently not going to tolerate any discussions. David Pereira da Costa (Lens) is given a yellow card for dissent.
88' Nabil Bentaleb (Lille) goes into the book for bad language. His vulgar comments could have made it worse. Luckily for him, it's a yellow card.
86' Franck Haise has decided to substitute Ruben Aguilar and he is replaced by Adrien Thomasson (Lens).
86' It will be a substitution. Alexsandro (Lille) is ready to enter the pitch as Gabriel Gudmundsson walks off.
86' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Remy Cabella (Lille) comes onto the pitch for Adam Ounas.
84' Florian Sotoca (Lens) gets on the end of a good pass and from mid-range he unleashes a decent strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
81' The corner is swung in but Lille can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
78' 2 - 1 Elye Wahi (Lens) gets on the end of a pass inside the box and fires into the bottom left corner. The goalkeeper was helpless.
77' Substitution. Adam Ounas (Lille) replaces Edon Zhegrova.
76' The resulting set piece from Lens is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

76' Elye Wahi (Lens) wins himself just enough space inside the box to connect with the corner. His header flies towards the roof of the net, but the goalkeeper leaps from the ground and makes a stunning save.
76' The referee signals a corner kick to Lens.
74' Lille failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
73' 5:0 – this is the current number of shots on target.
71' Jonathan David (Lille) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Brice Samba, who smothers the ball.
70' Franck Haise has decided to make a change. Andy Diouf (Lens) replaces Salis Abdul Samed.
68' Lille seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
67' Jonathan David (Lille) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly towards the bottom left corner, but Brice Samba is well positioned to make a comfortable save.
64' The referee shows a yellow card to Elye Wahi (Lens). No wonder. A clear yellow for bad language.
64' Whoa! Such gestures are commonly penalised and Edon Zhegrova (Lille) duly receives a yellow card.
61' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Massadio Haidara (Lens) comes onto the pitch so that Jhoanner Chavez can be given a rest.
61' Franck Haise has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Angelo Fulgini (Lens) replacing Przemyslaw Frankowski.
61' We are about to witness a substitution. Elye Wahi (Lens) is replacing Wesley Said.
60' 2 - 0 Goal! Edon Zhegrova (Lille) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low into the middle of the net. It's 2:0.

60' Gabriel Gudmundsson (Lille) unleashes a promising shot towards the bottom left corner after his wonderful solo run, but Brice Samba thwarts the effort with a fabulous save. The score remains the same.
58' Lille work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.

57' Nabil Bentaleb (Lille) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Lille.
57' Lille have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
56' Edon Zhegrova (Lille) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
55' Wesley Said (Lens) commits a foul and Willy Delajod immediately signals a free kick.
55' Jonathan David (Lille) finds himself in an offside position and the referee stops play after the linesman raises his flag.
52' The game is interrupted. Benjamin Andre (Lille) is given a yellow card. He has to be more careful now.
49' Wesley Said (Lens) fails to time his run beyond the last defender and the linesman makes a good call by signalling for offside after seeing the whole situation unfold.
49' A lofted cross from Jhoanner Chavez (Lens) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
48' Lille enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+3' The end of the first half.
45+2' Good movement by Wesley Said (Lens), but he can't find any of his teammates as the cross is poor.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' A cross from a corner kick by Lens is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
43' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Lens comes to nothing.
39' Wesley Said (Lens) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
35' The referee looks satisfied after his VAR review and duly changes the colour of the card shown to Facundo Medina (Lens) to a yellow. Play continues.

34' It's been a while since that contentious challenge by Facundo Medina (Lens), but referee Willy Delajod must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review and it could result in a red card!
34' A strict call by Willy Delajod! He pulls out the red card and sends Facundo Medina (Lens) off the pitch.
29' Nabil Bentaleb (Lille) picks up the ball and goes on a great solo run. He decides to shoot from mid-range but his attempt is comfortably blocked by a defender.
27' Lille can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
27' Jonathan David (Lille) takes a first-time shot from the edge of the box, but his effort is well blocked by the defender.
25' Wesley Said (Lens) starts his run too early and the referee blows for offside.
25' The up-to-date shots on target statistics – 2:0.
22' Jonathan David (Lille) latches on to a pass on the edge of the box, but he can't get any power into the shot and fails to trouble Brice Samba.
20' Jonathan David (Lille) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
19' Florian Sotoca (Lens) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
16' Willy Delajod blows his whistle after Jhoanner Chavez (Lens) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
14' Salis Abdul Samed (Lens) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Willy Delajod stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.
13' David Pereira da Costa (Lens) controls a nice low pass and shoots from just outside the box, but it's a poor effort that flies into the stands. Wasted opportunity!
12' Gabriel Gudmundsson (Lille) brings an opponent down and Willy Delajod interrupts the game.
12' Willy Delajod blows his whistle and it's Edon Zhegrova (Lille) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
9' 1 - 0 Edon Zhegrova (Lille) receives a well-taken defence-splitting low pass inside the box and scores! His great effort makes its way into the bottom right corner of the net.
6' Salis Abdul Samed (Lens) brings down his opponent with a very late tackle.
5' Florian Sotoca (Lens) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
5' Leny Yoro (Lille) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
3' Lille hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Lille will kick the game off.
Willy Delajod is introduced as the referee for today's match.
